difficulty.description: Official sources describe a medium stage, mostly through forest land on forest roads. The route passes some animal pastures where gates must be closed and animals not frightened. The last 3.6 km into Ulricehamn/Prången is asphalt on a pedestrian/cycle path, and official text says there are no prepared rest areas on the stage.

dogsLivestockPrivateLand.notes: Official route text says Etapp 7 passes some animal pastures; close gates and do not frighten animals. Dogs must be under strict control, and from March 1 to August 20 dogs must not run loose in nature; around grazing animals, especially with young, keep dogs controlled or avoid entering.

roadAndSurfaceHazards.notes: Mostly forest roads/forest land, with pastures/gates and a final 3.6 km asphalt pedestrian/cycle path. The Blackered start has weak public transport and likely rural-road approach if arriving by bus.

hunting.notes: No section-specific hunting warning found. General allemansrätt access remains, but visitors must not intentionally disturb hunting and should respect temporary local signs.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: No official closure or reroute for Etapp 7 was found on Borås, Västsverige, Naturkartan, Ulricehamn, SÄRF or Länsstyrelsen pages checked on 2026-04-29. Naturkartan still carries a whole-trail quality-assurance/signage/passability warning.

emergency.notes: For emergencies, call 112 and give exact location/nearest road. The final urban/lakeside approach has stronger road access than the Blackered start.

lanes.summary: Confirmed official label Blackered - Prångens Camping, 12 km, 3 h, Medium, surface/livestock/asphalt/rest-area notes, endpoint access, Brunns kyrkoruin and Prången/Prångens Camping services.
Audited Naturkartan GPX/API, Västsverige KML and OSM relation 5607242. Found one 838.6 m simplified chord requiring densification, plus Prångens endpoint/access-cluster ambiguity.

Found Blackered access, Brunns kyrkoruin, Brunnsnäs access points, Prångens Camping, Prångens badplats, Sturebadet/Kallbadhuset and Ulricehamn service metadata. Confirmed no reliable shelter/fireplace/prepared rest area along the main section.

Verified current Västtrafik/GTFS access. Komskälet/Kommskälet appears stale; Bredaslätt line 201 is the best scheduled Blackered access despite a long rural-road walk. Prången endpoint has strong bus access at Bronäs/Karlsnäs/Ågatan and Ulricehamn busstation.
Found no current stage-specific closure/reviews. Collected older corridor reports, Brunns kyrkoruin collapse-warning context, and recent Prångens Camping/NorCamp/Campcation service reviews.
Confirmed livestock/gate/dog rules, no stage-specific protected-area rule unless geometry clips nearby Kråkebo, dynamic SÄRF fire status, no reliable on-stage water and no official closure.

importReadiness.summary: Section 7 has enough official source, GPX/API/KML/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field-report and rules/safety evidence for normalization. It is not ready for direct runtime import because the geometry must be densified, the Prångens Camping endpoint/access cluster is semantically ambiguous, Blackered transit is weak, Komskälet appears stale, and endpoint facilities need deduplication.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 7 runs from Blackered to Prångens Camping/Ulricehamn. It is a medium 12 km stage, mostly on forest roads through forest land and pastures, where gates must be closed and grazing animals left undisturbed. The last 3.6 km follows asphalt pedestrian/cycle path into the Prången/Ulricehamn service area. There are no prepared rest areas on the section itself; the main service concentration is at Prångens Camping, Prången badplats and nearby Ulricehamn. Brunns kyrkoruin is the main heritage POI, but it should be shown with structural/collapse-warning caution.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 7 GPX/API as canonical geometry and densify/resample long chords, especially the 838.6 m chord near Prången. Use Västsverige KML as supporting official-linked geometry and OSM relation 5607242 as a corridor/access cross-check, not as a wholesale replacement.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use Naturkartan GPX endpoints for route-line continuity. Model Blackered and Prångens Camping/Prången as access/facility clusters; at Prångens, preserve the 255 m difference between the Naturkartan route endpoint and the Borås/KML campsite-access coordinate.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Blackered as start access metadata with parking/information caveat.
Import Brunns kyrkoruin as a heritage POI with collapse-warning/sensitivity note.
Keep Brunns kyrkoruin parking/information bay pending exact coordinates.
Model Brunnsnäs parking/info and Brunns kyrka stop as intermediate access metadata only after current access/transit verification.
Import Prångens Camping as paid endpoint camping/lodging/service with customer-utility caveats.
Import Prången badplats as endpoint swimming/service cluster, deduplicated with camping services.
Model Sturebadet/Kallbadhuset and Ulricehamn center services as nearby service metadata only if import scope includes off-route town services.
Suppress unnamed OSM bench/waste/picnic micro-amenities because official text says no prepared rest areas.
majorCaveats: Naturkartan/STF QA and reroute warnings conflict with Västsverige stage 3-7 quality-assured statement.
Raw Naturkartan GPX/API and Västsverige KML have an 838.6 m simplified chord that must be densified before import.
Prångens Camping route-line endpoint and official/campsite access coordinates differ by about 255 m.
Blackered public transport is weak; best scheduled option is Bredaslätt with about 4.9 km road walk.
Komskälet/Kommskälet appears in trail access text but was not found in current GTFS/Västtrafik stop data.
No shelter, fireplace, prepared rest area or reliable on-stage drinking water was found before Prångens.
importReadiness.nextSafeStep: Commit this section packet, then proceed to section 8 six-agent batch with special attention to the Prångens Camping/Böne kyrka endpoint semantics, Böne coordinate typo, overlaps with Åsundenleden/Redvägsleden and Ulricehamn/Åsunden facilities.
